Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento.

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta.

  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

title: Senior R&D Subsea Engineer
description:
Domaine Recherche Innovation & Développt

Type de contrat: CDI

Expérience Minimum: 6 ans

- As part of TotalEnergies company, this position is required to support the strategy in its technological ambition. Specifically, you will reinforce the deep offshore team to ensure the progress of Subsea Technologies. Flow-Assurance and correlated technologies connected to subsea processing is a key area to develop into the position.

- The R&D in EP is a strategic tool for the TotalEnergies Group and its EP growth as well as the Strategic alliance with Petrobras.

Job Dimensions:

- The primary responsibility of this position is to support the Lead Deep Offshore Engineer in his mission.

- Participate in the follow-up / coordination / technology transfer of various collaborations / partnerships with Oil & Gas Companies.

- Participate in the Technical Committees related to various collaborations / partnerships in the Deep-Water Segment.

- Contribute to ensure active follow-up of HQ involvement in JIPs funded / co-funded by TotalEnergies under the lead Deep Offshore engineer supervision.

- Contribute to the Coordination of people (workforce) (Specialists from E&P or eventually from other Group branches, Partners, Research Institutes, Universities, Engineering, sub-contractors, PhD students, end of cursus trainees, post-PhD) under TEPBR R&D Deep Offshore Lead supervision.

- Contribute to ensure the compliance with ANP 1% obligation, fostering the maximization of its use in all R&D projects related to Deep-Water.

- Contribute to ensure the satisfactory progress of the R&D projects under execution by Academia and Brazilian Companies.

The employee shall perform his/her activities in compliance with the HSE Management System, aligned with One Maestro Principles and oriented to safeguard the integrity of people, bearing in mind to preserve the environment and resources by contributing to improve our energy efficiency and decarbonization of Company’s assets and reputation.

- Coordinate and steer various R&D Programs related to the selected Technologies for TotalEnergies E&P’s needs. Selected technologies will include elements like Subsea developments, long subsea tieback, Deep / Ultra deep offshore, Architecture, Support structures, as required.

- Represent TotalEnergies R&D under TEPBR R&D Deep Offshore Lead supervision / delegation in Research Consortia, Joint Industry Projects, Joint Testing Projects and external events.

- Contribute to identify, propose, and develop R&D collaborations & projects with universities, laboratories, institutes, Providers... addressing TotalEnergies’ strategy.

- Contribute to the preparation of budgets and funding application dossiers.

- As applicable, supervise new incomers and less experienced persons under learning process in relevant R&D activities.

- Develop and disseminate specialized knowledge in the team.

- Monitor technology development by competition, vendors, and academia; keep R&D informed on its impact.

- Promote the Company’s reputation within the professional and academic community.

- Issue timely R&D reports, meetings & conferences’ synthesis, work proposals and plans.

- Contribute to ensure technology development / qualification for the projects co-financed to meet TotalEnergies’ requirements.

- Participate to the follow-up / technology transfer of projects coordinated by TEPBR R&D.

- Participate under the supervision of TEPBR R&D Deep Offshore Lead to the Management of operated projects’ completion on-time, within the allocated budget, and communicate the results.

- Contribute under the supervision of TEPBR R&D Deep Offshore Lead to an effective interface particularly with the TotalEnergies Branch “OneTech” and its R&D teams (Pau, Paris and CDRs) and the Technical Lines. You can interface as well with Customer Lines (Paris, Pau) and with Affiliates when required, during the R&D activities and the evaluation/qualification activities.

- HSE & Quality: Ensure TEPBR compliance to the legislative and internal requirements relating to Health, Safety and Environment and that all R&D activities conducted in Brazil are carried out with fully acceptable level of HSE. Ensure that the requirements of the E&P Referential (Charters, Company Rules, and Specifications) and TEPBR's Company Management System CMS are complied with for all relevant disciplines.

Accountabilities:

- Contribute under the supervision of TEPBR R&D Deep Offshore Lead to the R&D activities in accordance with the multi-year program defined and validated by the project manager, the program manager, with a multidisciplinary approach.

- Contribute under the supervision of TEPBR R&D Deep Offshore Lead to the development of innovative solutions and the development of TotalEnergies' scientific expertise in line with the objectives of the R&D project and the transfer to the business lines.

- MSc degree in engineering or related disciplines.

- A minimum of 5 years’ experience related to Technology and Operations in R&D E&P and/or Project in subsea techno Flow Assurance themes, (i.e., Hydrates, Wax, Asphaltenes, Scales and Flow Modeling), knowledge and/or experience in SURF, SPS or Subsea Processing is required.

- Excellent technical analysis, interpersonal, oral, and written communication, organization, and presentation skills.

- Portuguese language is mandatory, fluency in English language is essential, and preferably some knowledge in French.

title: Agro Jangada - Uma Empresa do Grupo Syngenta
description:
Seja parte do futuro do agronegócio no Brasil

Em mais de 20 anos de trajetória, a Agro Jangada é uma das principais marcas do agronegócio no sul do Mato Grosso do Sul. Atualmente, conta com dez lojas, sendo a matriz em Itaporã e as demais nas cidades de Dourados, Naviraí, Laguna Carapã, Nova Andradina, Caarapó, Eldorado, Nova Alvorada do Sul, Chapadão do Sul, Chapadão do Céu/GO e Alto Taquari/MT.

Parte do Grupo Syngenta desde 2022 , atua na comercialização de insumos agrícolas , como sementes, adubos, defensivos para culturas como soja, milho, trigo, arroz e feijão, trazendo assim uma grande variedade de produtos e tecnologias para o produtor rural.

Para a Agro Jangada, a melhor forma de estar próximo dos agricultores e atender as suas necessidades, é garantir que tenham acesso a todos tipos de inovação no portfólio de produtos e serviços, que trazem cada vez mais produtividade, rentabilidade e sustentabilidade. Uma empresa com valores sólidos, forte compromisso com o agricultor e um time de pessoas verdadeiramente empenhadas em dar o seu máximo para encantar os clientes , a Agro Jangada oferece o que há de melhor no mercado para o produtor rural, da escolha ao tratamento da semente que vai para o campo.

A empresa mantém também um laboratório próprio , que permite a verificação da qualidade das sementes e um Centro de Tratamento de Sementes , certificado com o selo de excelência Seedcare e credenciado pelo Ministério da Agricultura, garantindo o tratamento de sementes com dosagens homogêneas para levar uniformidade e segurança ao plantio.

Venha ser parte do nosso time e contribuir para o crescimento sustentável do agronegócio brasileiro!

Formada por empresas independentes que, em sinergia, oferecem múltiplas soluções para o sucesso do agricultor, a SYNAP (Syngenta Agriculture Platform) é composta pelas marcas Atua Agro , Dipagro , Agro Jangada , Agrocerrado e Produtécnica . Mantendo suas identidades, suas histórias e seus relacionamentos locais, as bandeiras oferecem soluções financeiras, assistência técnica e tecnologia para o sucesso do agricultor.

Somos formados por um time de pessoas colaborativas , com valores sólidos e com ambição . Para nós, o sentimento de pertencimento permite que as pessoas sejam as melhores versões de si mesmas e constrói um ambiente cada vez mais acolhedor e produtivo. Acreditamos no potencial dos nossos colaboradores e incentivamos o processo de desenvolvimento contínuo, alinhado com a aspiração de cada profissional.

Atualmente possuímos aproximadamente 90 lojas espalhadas pelas principais regiões agrícolas brasileiras e contamos com +1000 colaboradores . Nosso time não para de crescer!

Desde 1982, criando, transportando e compartilhando valor com toda a sociedade. Ficamos muito felizes com tanto reconhecimento, o que nos motiva a fazermos ainda mais.
Sim, estamos com muitas vagas abertas!
Estamos crescendo muito, por isso, temos diversas oportunidades de crescimento profissional em várias linhas de atuação.
Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Confira o que é preciso.

  • Por fim, ter disponibilidade para residir em Belo Horizonte imediatamente ou, se ainda estiver cursando a graduação em outra cidade, ter disponibilidade após sua finalização.

Você, como trainee, vai vivenciar cultura da SYDLE, passará por treinamentos, participará de times colaborativos e multidisciplinares, além de atuar ao lado de grandes profissionais. Então, se você quer crescer, aprimorar conhecimentos e ganhar vivência empresarial, você está no lugar certo! Além disso, para a gente, flexibilidade é papo sério! Juntos, desenhamos a sua trajetória de acordo com as suas habilidades e características individuais.

Nosso processo seletivo acontece de forma rápida, com até três fases. Entraremos em contato com todos os selecionados para mais informações sobre as etapas. Aguarde! :D

Será incrível receber seu currículo e saber do seu interesse pelo nosso time! Mas caso seu currículo não seja selecionado para essa vaga, não se preocupe! Você ficará automaticamente em nosso banco de talentos para oportunidades futuras.
Conte com a SYDLE!
Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas e plurais. Queremos crescer juntos e acreditamos que, quanto mais diverso e autêntico for o nosso time, mais rico será o nosso dia a dia. Dessa forma, buscamos ter um olhar diferenciado e cuidadoso para essa pauta nas nossas seleções. E, caso você precise de alguma adaptação especial em nosso processo seletivo ou se tiver dificuldades em custear seu deslocamento para participar das avaliações, conte com a gente e informe o RH ao agendar as etapas.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software (Vaga Afirmativa Prioritária para Pessoas Negras), INTech Latam
description:
Amazon.com's long-term vision is to enable a seamless global shopping experience for all Amazon customers worldwide on any Amazon website or device, in any language and for any culture. Our goal is to create software that offers customers a unique shopping experience that is internationalized for their preferences.

Our team is responsible for automating the launch strategy for Amazon's expansion into new countries. We build customer-facing features in a highly distributed environment that directly impacts Amazon’s e-commerce revenue in over 150+ countries.

About you:

You're looking for a career where you'll be able to build, to deliver, and to impress. You build customer facing features that reach millions of new customers all over the world. You look at problems holistically, and thrive on the intricate complexity of designing feedback loops and ecosystems. You want to work on projects where you are leveraging Machine Learning models to implement solutions to real problems that require creative and deep understanding of the problem space. You challenge yourself and others to constantly come up with better solutions. You work closely with the business to define the expansion strategy and figure out innovative solutions to help this thriving business continue its exponential growth.

About us together:

We're going to eliminate vendor complexity so they can make products available in any market place. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make tough decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team.

The ideal engineer for this space will be highly quantitative, have great judgment and passion for building a great customer experience, be inventive, and have a strong track record of delivery. You also have a pragmatic approach and iterative approach to building software: you have an ability to simplify and get things done with a demonstrated track record of building and delivering software and working effectively with external and internal teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  2. 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  3. Experience programming with at least one software programming language

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  2. Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa.

Job Description

The Senior Manager – Commercial Solutions Sales Leader – PUB is responsible for accelerating the penetration and adoption of B2B payments in the markets by working with our Financial Institution Clients, Acquirers, and Fintechs to expand our solutions for both Small Businesses and the Large and Medium Market segments, B2B Verticals, and new payment flows. The Senior Manager – PUB will lead key go-to-market initiatives, including:

  • Establishing, developing, and managing the relationship between Visa and VCS Clients and Prospects, setting the direction and implementation of VCS strategies in the country to achieve business objectives through the growth of existing business and the identification of new business opportunities.
  • Conducting competitive assessments to identify needs, gaps, and business opportunities.
  • Identifying key industry trends and developing sales action plans, enabling and delivering content and education to support internal and external clients and spread the B2B innovation narrative for the segment.

This person will work with various stakeholders within the group and across Visa to execute deliverables.

The Senior Manager, Commercial Solutions Leader (Sales) – PUB brings a deep passion for collaboration and ecosystem building, as well as for technology and payments, a futuristic vision, the ability to understand and assemble trends in respective industries, and a deep understanding of the B2B payments landscape. They will drive co-creation and human-centered design engagements with clients and partners in PUB to jointly develop next-generation innovative solutions and proposals for businesses of all sizes, leveraging both our partners and Visa’s capabilities. They will work on highly complex topics, leading multidisciplinary projects with minimal supervision in a dynamic and ambiguous work environment, and will have the ability to independently translate high-level guidance into detailed deliverables. They will demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and executive presence.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the establishment, direction, and implementation of VCS strategies and business plans for PUB to increase B2B payment penetration, Visa’s market share in the segment, and business objectives through existing business growth and new business opportunities.
  • Establish, develop, and manage the relationship between Visa and VCS clients, prospects, partners, and enablers.
  • Manage VCS objectives, revenue generation, and pipeline. Monitor business results, anticipate challenges, and take proactive actions to achieve business goals.
  • Identify, size, and prioritize new business development opportunities and take responsibility for managing the evaluation and execution of these projects.
  • Lead strategic initiatives across the market to expand B2B accounts payable and receivable programs with issuers, acquirers, processors, enablers, and Visa teams to ensure last-mile execution and program performance.
  • Assess market needs, define, prioritize, and lead key VCS go-to-market activities with Visa stakeholders across multiple workstreams, highlighting plans, risks, and dependencies.
  • Position as a sales leader and subject matter expert in SMB, LMM, Verticals, Accounts Payable and Receivable.
  • Work with internal cross-functional teams across regions to expand necessary functionality, address barriers, and secure funding to advance key initiatives.
  • Develop strategic partnerships to bring creative B2B payment solutions to market, amplify impact, and accelerate time to market.
  • Actively monitor trends and developments in B2B payments and commerce, develop opinions/ideas on their implications for Visa, and socialize internally and externally with key stakeholders.
  • Work closely with product teams, innovation designers, and implementation teams to identify the right B2B topics, partners, and user experiences to prototype, commercialize, and scale quickly.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD


Preferred Qualifications

  • 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in commercial payments and/or wholesale/small business banking (cash management, supplier payments, invoice processing, e-invoicing, supply chain finance, procurement, treasury, financial operations, business travel, etc.)
  • Ideally, experience in commercializing solutions for businesses of all sizes and across all verticals/use cases.
  • Ideally, experience in product management or consulting/investment banking.
  • Experience evaluating a technology landscape, preferably within payments and commerce.
  • Passion for technology, futuristic vision, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Experience working in project-based and matrix reporting environments.
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish.

title: Pre-Sales Data Scientist - 218910
description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. That’s why we built the most complete cloud analytics and data platform for AI. By delivering harmonized data, trusted AI, and faster innovation, we uplift and empower our customers and our customers’ customers to make better, more confident decisions. The world’s top companies across every major industry trust Teradata to improve business performance, enrich customer experiences, and fully integrate data across the enterprise.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Data Scientist (pre-sales) is an experienced and expert Data Scientist, able to provide industry thought-leadership on Analytics and its application across industries and across use-cases. The Senior Data Scientist supports the account team in framing business problems and in identifying analytic solutions that leverage Teradata technology and that are disruptive, innovative - and above all, practical. An articulate and compelling communicator, the Senior Data Scientist establishes our position as an important partner for advanced analytics with customers and prospects and is a trusted advisor to executives, senior managers and fellow data scientists alike across a range of target accounts. They are also a hands-on practitioner who is ready, willing and able to roll-up her sleeves and to deliver POC and short-term pre-sales engagements. The Senior Data Scientist has an excellent theoretical and practical understanding of statistics and machine learning and has a strong track record of applying this understanding at scale to drive business benefit. They are insanely curious and is a natural problem-solver and able to effectively promote Teradata technology and solutions to our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

The successful candidate will work with other expert team members to:

  • Provide pre-sales support at an executive level to the Teradata account teams, helping them to position and sell complex Analytic solutions that drive sales of Teradata software.
  • Provide strategic pre-sales consulting to executives and senior managers in our target market.
  • Support the delivery of PoC and PoV projects that demonstrate the viability and applicability of Analytic use-cases and the superiority of Teradata solutions and services.
  • Work with the extended Account team, and Sales Analytics Specialists to develop new Analytic propositions that are aligned with industry trends and customer requirements.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • a degree level qualification (preferably Masters or PHD) in Statistics, Data Science, the physical or biological sciences or a related discipline
  • Have proven hands-on experience of complex analytics at scale for example in the areas of IoT and sensor data.
  • Understand the PMML and ONNX model portability standards
  • Have experience with Teradata partner’s analytical products, Cloud Service providers such as AzureML and Sagemaker and partner products such as Dataiku and H2O
  • Have strong hands-on programming skills in at least one major analytic programming language and/or tool in addition to SQL

What You’ll Bring

  • An expertise in Data Science with a strong theoretical grounding in statistics, advanced analytics, and machine learning and at least 5 years real-world experience in the application of advanced analytics.
  • A passion about knowledge sharing and demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional development.
  • A Belief in Teradata's Analytic solutions and services and be a commitment to working with the product, engineering, and consulting teams to ensure that they continue to lead the market
  • An ability to turn complex technical subject matter into relatable easy to digest and understand content for senior audiences.

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

The role is client facing with both service and sales at the heart of the position, which is aimed at increasing revenue across the customer base through strong understanding of the games and products on offer as well as maximising the games uptake. The role is expected to build and maintain strong relationships with all key customers in the Latam Market with significant focus on Brazil, pitching content and consistent service delivery. An in-depth knowledge of casino games and the igaming industry, along with being fluent in English, Brazilian Portuguese, with other languages such as Spanish desirable. Experience across commercial, analytical, operational and marketing (ideally gained within the igaming industry) areas is a prerequisite for the role.


Responsibilities

• Make data a key part of the Regional games managers role in engaging with customers
• Work with Revenue team leads for opportunities for synergies and growth
• Work on processes for selling games for the regional games management team and processes with other teams
• Responsible for identifying opportunities and building / executing strategies and targets to deliver increased game uptake, distribution and revenue growth
• Identifying suitable commercial incentives and casino game upsell (new and existing content) across all product vertical to drive market revenue
• Ability to execute commercial negotiations, with a full understanding of implications when entering into negotiation and planning of promotional incentives
• Design and execution of a strategic games sales plan, including showcasing of the games to existing and new customers within the region, and setting targets for driving revenue growth

• Actively forecast and manage key account and sales metrics to report to key stakeholders, such as game uptake across the customer network and revenue generation
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers at all levels of seniority through consistent sales, service delivery and business development
• Work with wider team, maintain working knowledge of competitors and industry trends
• Contribute new ideas on how to improve our game offering; pro-actively improving and sharing knowledge of industry competitors, news, changes and developments across the team
• Encourage and develop new and existing relationships with the key customer contacts to further promote game uptake
• Drive exclusive distribution of games in core operators and Latam markets, with predominant focus on the Brazilian market
• Driving Growth in the Latam markets with predominant focus on the Brazilian market


Qualifications
  • Comprehensive understanding of the online gaming industry, relevant markets, competitors and consumers.
  • Ability to make data driven decisions
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Ability to present, communicate and influence in a credible and impactful manner.
  • Ability to clearly communicate business and technical issues, ideas, and recommendations.
  • Display a clear knowledge of how to generate results in a complex commercial environment
  • Excellent communication, organizational, teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Sound commercial and business awareness.
  • The ability to think strategically.

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience within the online gaming industry.
  • Relevant tertiary education (degree or diploma in a related field).
  • Experience working in a B2C role involving regular face to face client meetings.
  • Experience across commercial, analytical, operational and marketing functions is essential.
  • Fluent in English, Brazilian Portuguese, with other languages such as Spanish desirable.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners

We help remodelers automate estimating, streamline operations, and win more work—backed by real-time cost data, intuitive design, and workflows that “speak contractor.” With over 10,000 monthly active users and $6B in annualized project volume already flowing through our platform, we’re becoming the trusted partner for the people who build our homes.

We are backed by $25M+ raised from Y Combinator, Sequoia, Initialized, and Greycroft. Our team is distributed across hubs in Austin, São Paulo, and Buenos Aires, and we are deeply focused on building intuitive, high-impact solutions that make a real difference for our users.

Senior AI/ML Engineer at Handoff

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer you have a strong foundation in machine learning, computer vision, and the adaptability to tackle diverse challenges. As a generalist on our team, you will focus on solving real-world business problems by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques and proprietary datasets. This role requires a balance of technical expertise, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to collaborate across teams to deliver impactful solutions.

What you'll do

  • Apply traditional and modern ML techniques to build solutions that address key business challenges, such as enhancing estimate accuracy or streamlining AI agent features.
  • Utilize our extensive blueprint dataset to explore and develop innovative computer vision solutions, driving unique value in our product offerings.
  • Identify and implement the most effective ML tools and approaches, ensuring alignment with both immediate project goals and broader business needs.
  • Establish evaluation frameworks to measure and improve the effectiveness of deployed models, iterating based on results to achieve reliable outcomes.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to integrate ML solutions seamlessly into production, ensuring scalability, reliability, and user-centric design.
  • Keep abreast of advancements in both computer vision and machine learning research, adopting promising methods to enhance our capabilities.

About You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning, with a proven ability to apply techniques across domains like NLP, computer vision, and predictive analytics.
  • Proficiency in foundational ML tools: Pandas , NumPy , OpenCV , and scikit-learn .
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch .
  • Familiarity with working on computer vision tasks, such as image recognition, object detection, and processing large datasets like blueprints (e.g. YOLOv8 , Detectron , and others).
  • Hands-on experience with data engineering tools (e.g., SQL, Apache Airflow) for building pipelines.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for deploying ML solutions.
  • A team player who communicates effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and success in delivering impactful solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work effectively with proprietary datasets to unlock innovative solutions.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal

What we offer

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Attractive stock options
  • Unlimited PTO
  • We’ll set you up with all the equipment you need - and you can choose the laptop!
  • Get ready for regular team offsites around the world. Our 2024 offsites were in Poland, Mexico and Florida.
If you are passionate about developing cutting-edge machine learning solutions and want to be part of a team that values innovation, scalability, and real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you!
